Package io.github.protasm.jvmud.language.compiler

package io.github.protasm.jvmud.language.compiler
Source-to-bytecode LPC compilation, independent of a running game.

CompilationPipeline coordinates preprocessing, scanning, parsing, semantic analysis, typed IR lowering and JVM bytecode emission. Each stage exposes its own representations and diagnostics so readers can inspect how authored source becomes executable code.

The compiler consumes a read-only LPCCompilationEnvironment. Its default implementation, LPCCompilerContext, resolves sources and callable declarations without creating worlds, sessions, storage adapters or live LPC objects. Hosts select language features and compatibility transformations explicitly; original source remains intact.
